SEARCH
Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.loot

Interface GameLootService

public interface GameLootService
Independent main, Nether, End, and deathmatch pools with per-match frozen state. World, inventory, and generation operations must run on the Bukkit main thread.
Since:
1.6.0
